products.title: The Systems Field Guide
products.description: A concise operating manual for turning scattered expertise into a product people can understand and use.
products.longDescription: A practical release companion for independent experts. The guide moves from audience signal to offer architecture, production, launch, and the first useful feedback loop.
outcomes: Name the smallest valuable product you can ship
Build a credible proof path before launch day
Choose one activation metric that reflects real use

products.title: Launch Week Console
products.description: One operational view for assets, channels, dependencies, launch-day decisions, and the week-after review.
products.longDescription: A calm control surface for small teams and solo creators. It makes dependencies visible, keeps launch content tied to evidence, and preserves decisions after the campaign ends.
outcomes: See the critical path without another meeting
Separate launch signals from vanity activity
Turn one release into a reusable operating loop
